subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support remote `http(s)` avatars, or should remote avatar inputs remain accepted only for non-Control-UI surfaces and be clearly blocked/diagnosed in Control UI?
rationale: Current source deliberately prevents operator-browser remote image fetches while CLI/config still accept remote avatar values, so automation should not silently choose the CSP, privacy, and public contract tradeoff.

options.title: Keep Control UI local/data-only
options.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and update CLI help, docs, validation, and UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

options.title: Add same-origin remote-avatar proxy
options.body: Support remote avatars through a gateway-owned proxy or cache with explicit MIME, size, auth, caching, privacy, and network controls.

options.title: Allow direct remote image fetches
options.body: Let the browser load configured remote avatar URLs directly and accept the CSP and operator-browser privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep Control UI local/data-only
recommendation.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and update CLI help, docs, validation, and UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history across agent avatar support, avatar safety hardening, and Gateway/Control UI security surfaces.
